card.line: Timnath-serah was a city in the hill country of Ephraim that Joshua asked for as his own inheritance. He rebuilt it, lived there, and was buried there.

moments.title: Joshua's city
moments.text: After the land was divided, the Israelites gave Joshua the city of Timnath-serah, as the LORD had commanded and as he requested. He rebuilt the city and settled in it.

moments.title: Joshua is buried
moments.text: Joshua, the servant of the LORD, died at the age of 110. They buried him in his own inheritance at Timnath-serah, north of Mount Gaash.
